## 🇩🇪🔥 Welcome to **Berlin Bite Döner**

Craving **authentic German Döner kebab** in the heart of Vancouver?  
At **Berlin Bite Döner**, we bring the true taste of Berlin street food to Canada — freshly sliced, perfectly seasoned, and packed with flavor.

> *“Real Döner. Real Berlin. Right here in Vancouver.”* 🥙✨

From homemade sauces to freshly baked bread, every bite is crafted with passion and tradition.

---

### 🍽️ What We Serve

We specialize in:

- 🥙 **Classic Döner Kebabs** — beef, chicken, or veggie  
- 🌯 **Döner Wraps** with fresh salads & signature sauces  
- 🍟 **Döner Box** with fries or rice  
- 🧆 **Vegetarian & vegan options**  
- 🥤 **Authentic German drinks** (Ayran, Fritz-Kola, etc.)  

Our customers include:

- Locals seeking fresh, flavorful meals  
- Tourists craving authentic Berlin street food  
- Students and workers looking for quick, satisfying lunch options  
- Ex-Germans missing the real taste of home 🇩🇪❤️  

---

### ⭐ Why Berlin Bite?

- ✅ **Authentic Berlin taste** – traditional spices & fresh ingredients  
- ✅ **House-made sauces** – garlic, spicy, Kräuter, yogurt & more  
- ✅ **Friendly atmosphere** – fast, casual, and welcoming  
- ✅ **Berlin street-food vibe** – simple, bold, unforgettable
